title: sites.onepage-brief-payload.candidate.v0.1
description: Candidate private Onepage source payload derived from the legacy Portal field inventory. This is not the six-field rendering input and does not establish submission, materials approval, payment or authority.
$comment: Shape validation is incomplete by design: x-legacy-max-utf16-code-units-before-trim is an annotation, not a JSON Schema assertion. The compatibility adapter must enforce the documented UTF-16 limits on the original strings before trim, reject duplicate JSON keys, validate the exact private payload bytes and apply the separately documented submission/material rules. It must not rewrite the bytes whose SHA-256 is referenced by the snapshot. JSON Schema maxLength is intentionally absent because it counts Unicode code points rather than JavaScript UTF-16 code units.
